boards.title: Your First Weekend at Montclair State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe campus sequence for getting oriented, finding useful spaces, and ending the weekend with a few familiar landmarks.

cards.title: Start with the Red Hawk Statue
cards.subtitle: First landmark on a self-guided campus loop
cards.notes: Begin outside and use the statue as a visual anchor before following the self-guided map toward the Student Center and the south end of campus.
cards.short_summary: A documented self-guided-tour photo stop that helps set the route.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State's self-guided tour map identifies the Red Hawk Statue as a selfie stop.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; follow campus access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Center for Environmental and Life Sciences
cards.title: Find the CELS skyline view
cards.subtitle: Center for Environmental and Life Sciences
cards.notes: Walk to the CELS area and pause for the New York City skyline view marked on the university's self-guided tour map.
cards.short_summary: A map-documented scenic pause on the campus tour.
cards.evidence_claim: The self-guided tour map identifies an NYC skyline view behind the Center for Environmental and Life Sciences.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor viewpoint; conditions and visibility vary.

cards.title: Spot “Red Hawk Country”
cards.subtitle: Student Center Annex exterior
cards.notes: Continue to the Student Center Annex and look for the “Red Hawk Country” lettering called out on the official self-guided tour map.
cards.short_summary: An official tour stop on the Student Center side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State's self-guided tour map identifies “Red Hawk Country” on the side of the Student Center Annex.
cards.access_notes: View from outdoor campus circulation areas.

cards.title: Pause at the Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: South campus, near Alumni Green
cards.notes: Use the Amphitheater as a daylight meeting point, then continue toward Alumni Green, College Hall, and Sprague Library without needing an indoor reservation.
cards.short_summary: A named campus destination on the official tour map.
cards.evidence_claim: The official self-guided tour map lists the Amphitheater as a designated photo stop.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; check campus conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Walk through Alumni Green
cards.subtitle: Bounded by College Hall, Sprague Library, Morehead Hall, and the Amphitheater
cards.notes: Take a slow pass through the Green and read the plaques, bricks, trees, and benches that connect the space to Montclair State alumni history.
cards.short_summary: A campus green space with documented alumni memorial features.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says Alumni Green is a campus green space for students, alumni, and visitors, with donated trees, benches, plaques, and bricks.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space in the campus core; visit during normal campus access.

cards.title: Look for the College Hall arches
cards.subtitle: Outside College Hall
cards.notes: From Alumni Green, head to College Hall and frame the white statues and exterior arches highlighted by the official self-guided tour.
cards.short_summary: An exterior architectural stop documented by Admissions.
cards.evidence_claim: The self-guided tour map identifies the white statues and arches outside College Hall as a selfie stop.
cards.access_notes: View from outdoor walkways around College Hall.

cards.title: Settle into Sprague Library
cards.subtitle: Near Alumni Green and Susan A. Cole Hall
cards.notes: Step inside to locate the front desk, printing and laptop lending, then choose a public study area for a quiet reset between weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located library with documented study and support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Sprague Library's tour lists Access Services, printing, laptop lending, research help, and study-oriented spaces on its main level.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library's current hours before going; the library publishes hours online.

cards.entity_name: Open Swim at the Student Recreation Center
cards.title: Try an open-swim session
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center pool
cards.notes: If you have a valid Montclair State ID, check the current open-swim schedule and facility rules, then bring what you need for a relaxed indoor activity.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled campus-recreation option with published pool access requirements.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation lists open swim at the Student Recreation Center pool and requires a valid Montclair State University ID for entry.
cards.access_notes: Spring 2026 open swim lists Saturday 8 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; valid Montclair State ID required.

cards.title: Make dinner at Freeman Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Freeman Hall
cards.notes: Use your meal plan or another accepted payment method and check the dining page before walking over, since venue hours and availability can change.
cards.short_summary: A residential all-you-care-to-eat dining hall on the Montclair campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State identifies Freeman Dining Hall in Freeman Hall as an all-you-care-to-eat dining hall.
cards.access_notes: Check the live dining-hours page before visiting; payment or a meal-plan swipe is required.

cards.entity_name: Montclair State University main entrance sign
cards.title: Finish at the main entrance sign
cards.subtitle: Corner of Normal Avenue and College Avenue
cards.notes: Close the loop at the main entrance and take the sign photo called out by Admissions, then use the map to plan your next campus route.
cards.short_summary: A clearly identified exterior landmark at the campus entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State's self-guided tour map identifies the “Montclair State University” sign at the Normal Avenue and College Avenue entrance.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark at the campus entrance; use marked crossings when approaching from public streets.
